description: Full test coverage (unit + integration + e2e, all with mocked fetch/Prisma — no live network), documentation updates, and the user testing checklist. Pins every behaviour introduced by FEAT-001..003 so a future 'import unchanged' regression is caught. Depends on FEAT-001..003 being complete. The cross-FEAT integration run and the npm run verify gate happen in the convergence stage that follows this FEAT.
steps: Unit tests (Vitest, mocked fetch), tests/unit/ (design §9.1). pokewallet-price.test.ts (FR-1/AC-2/3): pickOnePiecePrice returns numeric market for a normal card and null (no throw) for a CM-only tcgplayer:null card; fetchOnePieceSetPrices maps a mocked /op/sets/OP01 body to a Map keyed by card_number; fetchPokemonCardPrice reads a price from a mocked /search body and returns null on empty results. scrydex-price.test.ts (FR-2/AC-5/6): pickRawPrice returns market/low from the type:'raw' entry and null when absent; pickGradedPrice returns the type!='raw',company:'PSA',grade-matching entry and null otherwise, against the real variants[].prices[] fixture from the contracts; variant/condition verbatim with 'NM'/'normal' defaults (NOT 'Near Mint'/'Normal'); building headers without SCRYDEX_TEAM_ID throws; gameSlug(POKEMON)==='pokemon', gameSlug(ONE_PIECE)==='onepiece'; resolveScrydexCard picks the entry whose number matches (normalizing '4/102'->'4', stripping leading zeros) AND set matches, returns null on no number+set match, does the name+number single-match fallback — all over a mocked fetch, no live call. scrydex-trend-backfill.test.ts (FR-4/AC-10): the backfill helper produces exactly the -1/-7/-14d absolute points via market - price_change, skips null deltas, labels them scrydex-trend (pure helper, no Prisma).

Integration tests (Vitest, mocked Prisma + fetch), tests/integration/ (design §9.2). scrydex-pricing.test.ts (FR-4/AC-9/11/12): pullAndStoreScrydexPrice writes one scrydex PricingHistory + upserts one CurrentPrice on a fresh pull; skips entirely (no fetch, no row) when a recent SyncLog(job='scrydex_history',cardId) within SCRYDEX_STALE_MS exists; proceeds when the newest such SyncLog is older or absent; writes SyncLog{status:'ok',credits:1} on success and {status:'failed',credits:0} when the pull returns null. portfolio-snapshot.test.ts (FR-5/AC-13): POST add writes an add-snapshot PricingHistory point for a priced card, skips it for an unpriced one, and the add still succeeds either way; assert assignBulkAddOrder ordering is untouched (keep bulk-add-order.test.ts green — change that F-15 test FIRST only if behaviour shifts). graded-routing.test.ts (FR-6/AC-16): a Scrydex priceSource yielding a PSA market -> resolveGradedPrice returns it with isFallback:false; null -> curated/multiplier value with isFallback:true (reuse golden fixtures); the new GET /api/cards/[id]/graded route (mocked Prisma + resolveScrydexCard/fetchScrydexCardById) returns {price,isFallback:false} for a priced Scrydex-PSA card and {price:null}+HTTP 200 for an unknown/unpriced card (NFR-4). history-null-safe.test.ts (NFR-2/NFR-4): /api/cards/[id]/history drops priceMarket==null rows and returns {points:[]}+200 for unknown; /api/cards/[id]/prices returns {prices:[]}+200 (not 404/500) for unknown + error; /api/users/me/collection/history skips null-priced rows so a card with no priced history contributes 0 only by absence. Existing psa-price/golden/graded-pricing.golden tests must stay green.

e2e specs (Playwright, standalone build on :3001; requires the enriched schema pushed in FEAT-001 and ideally a seed card with real PricingHistory points), e2e/ (design §9.3). portfolio-real-chart.spec.ts (authed): search -> add a card -> dashboard portfolio chart renders a real series when history exists, else the empty state, no crash; assert the chart element and a non-mock data signal where feasible. card-detail-chart.spec.ts (authed): open a card detail -> price-history chart renders real points if present, graceful short/empty line otherwise; reuse chart-interactivity.spec.ts conventions. Extend scanner.camera.spec.ts: with Scrydex Vision mocked at the network layer (or unresolved), the fake-media-device scan falls back to Tesseract via ocrSource:'unavailable' and still produces candidates. Extend graded-add-flow.spec.ts: add a PSA 10 copy and assert a graded price shows (Scrydex-backed when available, fallback otherwise, distinction via flags).

Docs (AGENTS.md top rule — same commit as the code they describe). docs/API_REFERENCE.md: add GET /api/cards/[id]/graded (contract + 200-fallback), the now-200 /api/cards/[id]/prices, and the history/recognize contracts. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §Data model: CurrentPrice/SyncLog/enriched PricingHistory, the Scrydex store-and-reuse flow, the price-fallback chain (TCGdex->PokeWallet/BerryWallet; apitcg catalog). docs/CODE_MAP.md: the new scrydex-pricing.service.ts module + the new tests + the new graded route.

USER TESTING CHECKLIST at .agents/tasks/USER_TESTING_CHECKLIST.md (FR-9): a concrete step-by-step manual script with EXACT expected results and how to distinguish real data from a graceful '—' fallback, covering: catalog search both games; add to collection; portfolio average graph (real + grows on next pull); card-detail price + real chart; One Piece pricing via BerryWallet; Pokemon pricing via TCGdex->PokeWallet fallback; PSA graded via Scrydex; scanning via Scrydex Vision + Tesseract fallback; daily sync via GET /api/cron/sync-cards (CRON_SECRET-guarded). Fold in the Vision/One-Piece-slug resolution outcome recorded by FEAT-001 ('—' = no data, not a bug).

BUILD-TOPOLOGY FIX (minimal, required for e2e): next.config.ts gained `outputFileTracingRoot: import.meta.dirname`. Without it, running inside this nested git worktree made Next infer the PARENT repo (its package-lock.json) as the file-tracing root and emit the standalone server at `.next/standalone/.worktrees/api-integration/server.js`, so the Playwright webServer's `node .next/standalone/server.js` 404'd (MODULE_NOT_FOUND). Pinning the root keeps the standalone server at `.next/standalone/server.js` everywhere (identical Docker/Vercel topology when the repo is not nested). One-line config change, no behaviour change.
